hero.title: UX Designer who forgot to stop at Figma.
hero.description: Based in Ticino, Switzerland — with +4 years closing the gap between beautiful and buildable. From Double Diamond to code. Developers ship faster. Users leave happy.

skills.title: You can count on me to...
skills.description: Develop modern digital experiences that engage users and meet company's goals.

userCentered.title: User centered for real
userCentered.description: Before buying, users check if the platform is right for them. I designed a quiz that filters bad fits and converts the good ones faster.
userCentered.dialogDescription: Most platforms sell first and ask questions later. We flipped it. Before buying, users check if Euvetia is actually right for them. That honesty built trust, and trust converted better than any sales copy.

designThinking.title: Design thinking, not design guessing
designThinking.description: I don't open design until I understand the problem. It saves time, money, and a lot of redesigns.
designThinking.dialogDescription: Every project at Euvetia started with research, not assumptions. The Double Diamond process kept us honest and focused on what users actually needed.

b2bSaas.title: B2B and SaaS
b2bSaas.description: Complex dashboards, enterprise clients, real stakes. Designed for the people who never read onboarding tutorials.
b2bSaas.dialogDescription: Zycreate needed an intuitive interface for interior designers managing complex 3D projects. I simplified workflows so pros could focus on creating, not clicking.

startupPace.title: Startup pace
startupPace.description: A project 12 months behind schedule. I joined and delivered in 3. Turns out it was all about communication and getting your hands dirty.
startupPace.dialogDescription: Zyhub was 12 months behind when I joined. By aligning stakeholders and shipping iteratively, we delivered in 3 months. Speed comes from clarity, not shortcuts.

figmaMcp.title: Figma MCP
figmaMcp.description: Figma MCP and Claude Code are part of my daily process. I'm genuinely curious about what comes next.
figmaMcp.dialogDescription: I use Figma MCP and Claude Code daily to bridge design and development. This portfolio was built with that exact workflow.

designSystems.title: Design systems
designSystems.description: I build design systems the way I'd want to receive them as a developer. Clean, documented and scalable.
designSystems.dialogDescription: A seasonal planting tool I designed and built from scratch, using a design system that scales from tokens to full pages.

work.title: Work that explains itself.
work.description: From human behavior to programming best practices, every decision has a reason. These are details that best show how I think.

intentionalDesign.title: Every pixel has a reason
intentionalDesign.description: Designed with one goal: what does this person need to feel confident enough to act?

complexToSimple.title: Complex to simple
complexToSimple.description: Swiss law is intimidating. It shouldn’t be. So I made it a personalized, intuitive and modern bento box.

speakingCode.title: Speaking code
speakingCode.description: A personal gardening problem became a seasonal planting tool I designed and built from scratch.

stories.brazil: I grew up in a small town in southern Brazil, raised by my grandparents and surrounded by nature, creative activities and music.
stories.school: At 15, I joined a military high school. I woke up at 5am, marched in the cold... It was hard, but it taught me strong values and I met the love of my life there. At school we built a mental health app together and got recognised by Google. Since then, we are always creating new things together.
stories.alps: Now I live in Biasca, a small city in the Swiss Alps. The lifestyle here pulls you in every direction: calisthenics, sourdough, lake swims, mushroom hunting, mountain hikes, piano and acoustic guitar. Every month I volunteer at the local retirement home. I'm convinced that a full life makes a better designer.
stories.philosophy: I believe Aristotle was right — the purpose of knowledge is action, not knowledge itself. I've been self-taught since the beginning, learning by doing, breaking things, and building them back better. I started in code. Then design took over, but the code never left. That combination is my biggest asset.
